text: Told through the recovered footage of the vanished paranormal researcher Masafumi Kobayashi, the film follows his investigation into a woman whose neighbours [hear babies crying in her house|images|babies, birth and pregnancy]. The threads spread: dead pigeons, a psychic girl gone missing, an actress weaving loops of wire in her sleep, and a mass hanging in a park. They lead to a village in Nagano abandoned for a dam, where [villagers once summoned the demon Kagutaba|origin|deliberately called up] and kept it with an annual rite, and to [stolen fetuses fed to a psychic girl|wrong|harm done to children].
